sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
After 3 RIGHT:
- Dark gray: rows 15-23, cols 9-17 (left panel) - moved LEFT!
- Black: rows 15-23, cols 45-53 (right panel) - moved RIGHT!
- Yellow: rows 45-53, cols 51-59 (right panel)
The dark gray moved from cols 18-26 to cols 9-17 (LEFT by 9). The black moved from cols 36-44 to cols 45-53 (RIGHT by 9). They didn't swap! They just moved in opposite directions again.
So the pattern is:
- When I move RIGHT, shapes on the left panel move LEFT and shapes on the right panel move RIGHT
- When I move LEFT, shapes on the left panel move RIGHT and shapes on the right panel move LEFT
This is a MIRROR movement! The two panels move in opposite directions.
So to swap the dark gray and black, I can't just cross the divider. The divider doesn't allow crossing - it's a mirror boundary.
Wait, but earlier in the game, the shapes DID swap. Let me think about how that happened.
Initially: black (15-23, 18-26) left, dark gray (15-23, 36-44) right
Now: dark gray (15-23, 9-17) left, black (15-23, 45-53) right
So the dark gray and black ARE swapped compared to the initial state. The dark gray is now on the left and the black is on the right. But they're at different columns (9-17 vs 18-26 for dark gray, 45-53 vs 36-44 for black).
So the swap DID happen at some point during my earlier exploration. But I don't know exactly how.
Let me reconsider the movement mechanics. When I move RIGHT:
- Left panel shapes move LEFT (mirror)
- Right panel shapes move RIGHT (normal)
When I move LEFT:
- Left panel shapes move RIGHT (mirror)
- Right panel shapes move LEFT (normal)
So the left panel is mirrored. Moving RIGHT moves left-panel shapes LEFT, and moving LEFT moves left-panel shapes RIGHT.
To get the dark gray from cols 9-17 to cols 18-26 (the initial black position), I need to move it RIGHT by 9. Since the dark gray is on the left panel (mirrored), I need to move LEFT 3 (9 cols) to move the dark gray RIGHT by 9.
Similarly, to get the black from cols 45-53 to cols 36-44 (the initial dark gray position), I need to move it LEFT by 9. Since the black is on the right panel (normal), I need to move LEFT 3 (9 cols).
So LEFT 3 would move both the dark gray RIGHT (to cols 18-26) and the black LEFT (to cols 36-44). This would restore the initial column positions!
Let me try LEFT 3.
